name: Tsukishiro Yoshimasa
source:
The founder of Mother. His motto is to never forget respect to people and to give them as many chances as needed. He especially dotes on Kagami and Yashiro, going so far as to get involved with each of them. He holds strong affection for Ayato as well, buying him anything he desires. He understands Ayato's tastes and is very generous towards him.

[Translated from in-game profile]

He has possessed the body of his second son, Tsukishiro Kouji / 月代 虹司, who was solely born to be his vessel.
